ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 80% of the fluke area, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels along the perimeter and a central vertical midline.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous zones on left and right lobes; a low-intensity vertical band (black) bisects the proximal center; low-intensity border (black) follows the trailing and leading edges; minor low-intensity punctate clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; a significant irregular indentation is visible on the inner trailing margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal margins tapering to acute points at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse circular dark pixel clusters (mottling) on the lower mid-section of the right lobe and high-intensity (white) circular spots on the inner left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 4-5 parallel dark vertical linear marks (rake-like disruptions) located on the outer trailing margin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced low-intensity marking at the peduncle-fluke interface; irregular notch topography suggests historic tissue loss or mechanical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, near-symmetrical dark vertical pigmentation stripe dividing the two high-intensity lobes.
